body: Good idea! I'll work on it.
What does this mean? Can I only include the definitions of enums and structures? I don't want to include the official DX10 header.

Basically, if a format relies specifically on the DXGI enum (BC6S, BC6U, BC7, RGB9E5, etc.), this structure needs to be written after the normal header (and the fourCC has to be set to 'DX10'). The DXGI format can be mapped to the DDSFormatInfo (like in the loader, but in reverse).
By 'header' I meant the serialized structure in the .dds file, not the c++ header
Everything past DDFCC_RGBA32F isn't present in the loader though, you may be confusing this with DXGI (which is an entirely different enum)
